# Luis Miguel Díaz Pichardo

**@Rhobtor**

I am a PhD student in Robotics and Mechatronics at the University of Málaga.

My work focuses on field robotics, autonomous navigation, robotic perception, and real-world deployment of unmanned ground vehicles in unstructured environments.

I use **Rhobtor** as my online nickname for GitHub and technical projects.

## Research interests

- Field robotics
- Autonomous navigation
- Unmanned ground vehicles
- Terrain-aware planning and control
- 2.5D elevation mapping
- Robotic perception
- ROS 2 and robotic software systems
- Embedded GPU deployment
- Search and rescue robotics
